definitions.explanation: A smooth, shiny appearance on a surface.
An attractive, alluring quality, especially in appearance.

examples.english: Her hair has a nice sheen.

examples.japanese: この{漆器|しっき}は{艶|つや}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.english: This lacquerware has a beautiful luster.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{肌|はだ}は{艶|つや}があって{若|わか}く{見|み}える。
examples.english: Her skin has a glow that makes her look young.

notes:
{艶|つや} describes a glossy, lustrous quality, often used for hair, skin, or polished surfaces.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {艶|つや}がある (to have luster/sheen)
- {艶|つや}がない (to lack luster, look dull)
- {艶|つや}を{出|だ}す (to bring out the shine)
- {艶|つや}やか (glossy, lustrous) [na-adjective]
- {艶|つや}{消|け}し (matte finish)

USAGE NOTES:
Often used to describe healthy-looking hair and skin, suggesting vitality and good health.
